title: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 routed-expert checkpoint vs streamed FP8 reference

reference.label: FP8 reference
reference.note: Official FP8 (e4m3 dynamic) checkpoint, streamed with bf16 compute via transformers. Verified byte-identical to 04c4e9e95c5da8862dced7e5056455116f83a7e0. Local path supplied on the DGX Spark node via BASE_MODEL_DIR.

candidate.label: NVFP4 candidate
candidate.note: Candidate checkpoint: ~97% of params are NVFP4 routed experts, remainder BF16. Local path via QUANT_MODEL_DIR.

expected_outputs.per_token_kld_spread: qbench kld / kld_p10 / kld_p25 / kld_p75 / kld_p90 per model + plot_kld_spread
expected_outputs.ppl_delta: candidate ppl / reference ppl, derived from qbench output.results JSON
expected_outputs.stored_bpw: qbench bpw_layer and bpw_head (true stored bits-per-weight)
